fusions.name: Roll Them Under
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Clamps on and rolls, which deals 26 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Surfacing Snap
fusions.desc: Lunges across a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 28 damage to everything in it and leaves it [Bleeding] for 8 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Log in the Shallows
fusions.desc: Veils you for 15 seconds: enemies notice you 75% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Waits for the Weak
fusions.desc: Against an enemy below half health, your damage rises 14%.
